examples.text: Herr General, die Soldaten sind einsatzbereit!
Die Feuerwehr ist von ihrem letzten Einsatz zurückgekehrt und nun wieder einsatzbereit.
„Selbst dem vielseitigsten, begabtesten und einsatzbereitesten Kandidaten müssen Zweifel kommen, ob er diese Fülle verschiedener Aufgaben und Ämter je bewältigen kann. “

glosses: Adventurous; venturesome; willing to undertake activities involving risk.

examples.text: [H]e ſhewed me a ſtately Palace, and how the People were clad in Gold that were in it; and how there came a venturous Man and cut his way through the armed men that ſtood in the door to keep him out; and how he was bid to come in, and win eternal Glory.

Let Prudence yet obſtruct thy venturous way; / And take good heed, what men will think and ſay: / That beauteous Emma vagrant courſes took; / Her father's houſe and civil life forſook; / That, full of youthful blood, and fond of man; / She to the wood-land with an exile ran.
